Pennsylvania announced Aug 25, 2026 what it called the state's first measles deaths in 35 years — 2 unvaccinated Lancaster County residents, one an infant who tested positive for measles and died of a splenic laceration. PA declined to release further identifying details citing privacy. CDC publicly disputed PA's 'measles-associated' framing, saying the Governor's office had not shared underlying case data or accepted CDC's offer of assistance; the county coroner has not confirmed either death was caused BY measles as of Aug 27, 2026.
